name: Pickled Cherries
description: Historical recipe from Common Sense in the Household (1871). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: Morella or large red tart cherries
ingredients.originalText: Morella or large red tart cherries

ingredients.name: To every quart: 1 large cup of vinegar
ingredients.originalText: To every quart: 1 large cup of vinegar

instructions.text: Put the vinegar and sugar on to heat with the spices.
Turn out into a covered stoneware vessel, cover, and let it get perfectly cold.
Fill small jars three-quarters of the way to the top with fruit.
Pour the cold vinegar over them.
Leave the stems on the cherries.

source.author: Marion Harland
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put the vinegar and sugar on to heat with the spices.
2. Boil five minutes.
3. Turn out into a covered stoneware vessel, cover, and let it get perfectly cold.
4. Strain out the spices.
5. Fill small jars three-quarters of the way to the top with fruit.
6. Pour the cold vinegar over them.
7. Cork or cover tightly.
8. Leave the stems on the cherries.
